column1: # The Blue Blood Rating knobs (were constants in build-data.mjs).
# tier_anchor_N = the last program in grouping #N (1-based): #3 Blue Blood Contenders
# title_selectors = space-separated national-title selectors that count.
# trend_recent_years = seasons the trajectory weighs as "recent" (default 10).
# trend_delta_points = how far a program's recent-decade rating must sit from its
#   all-time baseline (0-100 scale) to count as Ascending / Descending (default 8).
# trend_surge_points = the same distance that earns the emphatic stacked marker
#   (⏫ / ⏬) — a recent decade a whole class from the résumé (default 25).
# trend_min_history = a program with fewer FBS-era seasons on record than this gets
#   no arrow at all ("too new to chart"); default 30.
# tier_max_span = no grouping may span more than this many rating points; a wider
#   one is split at its largest interior gap (default 12).
